title: Notice on Binance Futures COIN-M System Upgrade (2026-06-30)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures COIN-M is undergoing a system upgrade  as per scheduled from 2026-06-30 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC)  (Market session state: Pending Trading). It is recommended that users with open positions in COIN-M Futures re-assess their collateral balances and the affected services listed  here  prior to the start of upgrade to mitigate against price fluctuations that may occur. There will be a 30 minutes cancel-only phase (Market session state: Cancel Only)  at 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC) . During the cancel-only phase, users are allowed to submit, modify or cancel Post-Only orders only.  All the services will resume (Market Session state: Continuous Trading) at 2026-06-30 07:30 (UTC) . Trading session details can be found at section 100.3 in the  Exchange Rules .  The system upgrade will take approximately 6 hours to complete. A separate announcement will be posted when the upgrade is complete. For more information, please refer to: Notice on Binance Futures COIN-M System Upgrade (2026-06-30) Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-30
